top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 discoveries (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) form a mature, clearly delimited achievement: the physiology of GLP-1 and identification of its active form established the principle behind incretin-based therapies, with decisive, field-changing clinical impact in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation and citation scope fit the discovery rather than a career, and all six members support it, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
